source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.13, printed page 240 (PDF 243). The cement flow diagram is our aid.

blocks.text: Petrochemical industry crude oil (kaccha tel) se plastics, synthetic rubber aur reshe (fibres) banati hai. Crude oil ko crack kiya jata hai (tor kar chhote molecules banaye jaate hain). Yeh chhote molecules lubricants (chiknai wale tel), waxes aur synthetic rubber ki bunyaad bante hain.

Cosmetics industry makeup, sabun aur perfumes (khushbuon) ke ajza banati hai. Yeh industry surfactants (sabun ke liye), emulsifiers (creams ko mulaim aur yaksan rakhne ke liye) aur preservatives (bacteria ki barhotri rokne ke liye) istemal karti hai. Chemistry yaqeeni banati hai ke yeh cheezein insaani jild (skin) ke liye pH-balanced hon, yani na zyada tezabi na zyada khaari (basic).

Cement industry limestone (choona pathar) aur clay (chikni mitti) se aik ahem tameeri cheez banati hai. Cement banane ke liye limestone aur clay ke achhi tarah mile hue mixture ko rotary kiln (ghoomne wali bhatti) mein 1500°C tak garam kiya jata hai. Jo cheez banti hai use gypsum ke saath pees kar cement banaya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar khane teeron se jure: limestone + clay -> rotary kiln (about 1500 degree C) -> ground with gypsum -> cement.
blocks.caption: Cement banane ke qadam (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Food industry food additives (khuraak mein milayi jaane wali cheezein), preservatives aur khuraak ki processing ke chemicals banati hai. Sodium benzoate zyada tar preservative ke taur par use hota hai. Hydrogenation se khane ke tel ko margarine jaisi thos charbi (solid fat) mein badla jata hai. Baking mein sodium bicarbonate (baking soda) jaise leavening agents (aata phulane wali cheezein) use hote hain. Fortification (khuraak mein ghizaiyat barhana) ke liye namak mein iodine ya tel mein Vitamin A milaya jata hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? (Did You Know?)
blocks.text: Paani milane par cement garam kyun hota hai? Cement paani se exothermic (hararat chhorne wala) hydration reaction karta hai aur garmi kharij karta hai. Isi liye taaza mila hua cement garam ho jata hai.

blocks.explanation: Limestone aur clay ka achhi tarah mila mixture rotary kiln mein 1500°C tak garam kiya jata hai, aur bani hui cheez ko gypsum ke saath peesa jata hai.

items: Petrochemicals: crude oil ki cracking se plastics, rubber, fibres.
Cement: limestone + clay, rotary kiln 1500°C, phir gypsum ke saath peesna.
Food: sodium benzoate, hydrogenation (margarine), baking soda, fortification.
